notes: The whole page is the uninterrupted continuation of one speech that began before this page and runs past its foot: eight justified paragraphs, not one speaker label anywhere, no stenographer note, no heading, no footnote and no footer. utterance_starts is therefore legitimately empty and anything the parser attributes to a speaker starting here is a false positive. The only italics are the foreign word 'default' (twice), which is emphasis inside the speech, not a stenographer note. The index CSV's opening_words shows the running header as '1 3 y 14 de octubre'; the page itself prints '13 y 14 de octubre de 2010' with no gap, so that space is an extraction artefact, not something printed.
